summary: Mostly no: on BTC, ETH and SOL, most Anchored VWAP settings did the same as random entries, including buying below the lower 2σ bands. Closing above the monthly VWAP beat random on 1h, 4h and daily, but each time the gap rested on one rally. The one result that held without its strongest stretch was a short above the daily upper 2σ band on 1h, in downtrends only, 0.1% better than random.

verdicts.use: Riding the trend (close above the monthly or weekly VWAP)
verdicts.text: Beat random on 1h, 4h and daily above the monthly VWAP, and on 1h above the weekly VWAP. Each result rests on one stretch, and without it the result was the same as random.

verdicts.use: Buying the dip (close below the lower 2σ band)
verdicts.text: Same as random below the daily or weekly lower 2σ band, on 1h, 4h and daily.

verdicts.use: Shorting stretches (close above the upper 2σ band)
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, and fragile on 4h. On 1h in downtrends the short beat random, but only at 10 and 20 candles.

verdicts.use: Trend side (close above the daily VWAP)
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, in both uptrends and downtrends. On 4h and daily it gave too few separate moves to judge.

notes: A close above the daily VWAP on 1h gave 83,007 entries in 454 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.02% behind random entries, inside the luck band. Uptrends and downtrends both came out the same as random. On 4h the pooled result had only 3 separate moves, too few to judge, and both regimes were the same as random there.

A close above the monthly VWAP beat random by 0.14% on 1h, 0.35% on 4h and 2.27% after 20 days on daily. On 1h the gap came from 1,428 entries between Jan 1, 2021 and Mar 3, 2021. On 4h it came from the run between Dec 29, 2020 and Mar 3, 2021, and on daily the result showed at 20 candles only. On 1h it beat random in uptrends but rested on the stretch between Aug 3, 2021 and Sep 14, 2021, and in downtrends it was the same as random.

Above the weekly VWAP on 1h, price beat random by 0.08%, and the result also showed at 10, 50 and 100 candles. It rests on 621 SOL entries between Oct 13, 2023 and Nov 13, 2023, and without them it was the same as random. Uptrends were the same as random. Downtrends beat random only because of the stretch between Dec 30, 2022 and Jan 10, 2023. On 4h it was the same as random.

Below the daily lower 2σ band on 1h, the 12,914 entries were 0.07% ahead of random, inside the band. ETH alone beat random by 0.11%, held without its strongest stretch, and showed at 20 and 50 candles but not at 10 or 100. The weekly lower band fires about half as often and was the same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. On 4h, BTC did 0.51% worse than random below the weekly lower band, but only because of signals on Jun 10–13, 2022, around the Celsius withdrawal freeze.

A short above the daily upper 2σ band on 1h was the same as random pooled, at 0.05%. In downtrends it beat random by 0.1%, held without its strongest stretch on May 10–11, 2022, during the Terra collapse, and showed at 10 candles but not at 50 or 100. In uptrends it was the same as random, at 0%. On 4h the 0.17% gap rests on SOL entries between Mar 4, 2025 and Jun 16, 2026, and showed at 20 candles only.

For a long DCA bot, a close below the lower 2σ bands adds no timing on these pairs, so the DCA orders and take profit do the work. The monthly VWAP is a trend filter to test beside other conditions, not a trigger, because its results rest on single rallies. The one shape to test is a 1h short above the daily upper 2σ band in downtrends, with a take profit sized for 10 to 20 candles. Leave the daily anchor out on daily candles: it gave too few separate moves to judge.
